The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been moved with prayer to direct the learned court of Judicial Magistrate, Court Room No.2, Muzaffar Nagar to decide the Case No.3065/9 of 2021 (State vs. Rizwan and others) arising out of Case Crime No.0226 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504,

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that a Case No.3065/9 of 2021 is pending before the learned court of Judicial Magistrate, Court Room No.2, Muzaffar Nagar since 2021 and it is not being decided, therefore, prays that a direction be issued to the learned court concerned to decide the same as expeditiously as possible.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Court Room No.2, Muzaffar Nagar since 2021
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as perusal of record and the order sheet, this application is disposed of finally with direction to the learned court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible within stipulated period as provided under aforesaid Act, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, in accordance with law, if there is no other legal impediment.
Order Date :- 15.3.2024
